note: Concept map used to match concerns as ideas rather than strings. Written by hand from the answer texts, published so the matching can be criticised. A concern maps to every concept whose pattern it matches; unmatched concerns keep their own identity as `other:<first three words>` so they still count toward union size.

concepts.unsigned_commitment: verbal|not signed|signed contracts|may still walk|stall|demand more|new blockers|hide other blockers|rarely convert|not guaranteed
concepts.sales_cycle_too_long: sales cycle|cycles outlast|outrun|outlast|close window|past one quarter|six-month runway|six months of runway
concepts.trial_leak_ignored: trial leak|drop-off|drop off|60%|leak keeps|churn and drop-off|compounds while
concepts.competitor_takes_deal: competitors|move to competitors|deals walk|prospects walk|revenue gone
concepts.activation_unproven: may not lift activation|cause unverified|conversion improvement|dramatic enough|conversion too slow
concepts.discipline_required: discipline|forcing function|hard scope limits|stealth full rewrite|quietly stalls|drifts into
concepts.schedule_slip_trust: both tracks slip|tracks slip|loses trust|loses faith|eroding ceo trust|late features|miss the quarter|slips past quarter
concepts.wrong_seams: seam boundaries|seams chosen|seams picked|boundaries picked|architecture review|bleeds into feature
concepts.debt_compounds: tech debt compounds|debt festers|rot compound|debt compounds
concepts.symptom_not_cause: treats symptom|admits errors|admitting product is broken|admitting failure|does not remove complaint|masks which error
concepts.user_burden: error tax|failure offloaded|manual work|fix-it-yourself|reads as work|costs user time|refuse manual
concepts.no_feedback_loop: telemetry|feed back|feeds model|retraining|training data|feature feels performative|only pays off
concepts.silent_churn: silent churn|churn silently|never see it|never opening|silent churners|some churn continues
concepts.audio_quality_floor: bad audio|base accuracy trails|vertical vocabularies still fail
